item.description:
• Your kit's nightly enrichment now runs for a time rather than a count. It measures how fast your model is going and stops at the batch that would take it past its share of the night: 10, 20 or 30 minutes, depending on your Sleep Quality setting. A fast model clears its whole backlog in one night, and a slow one gets a steady, bounded share.
  • The dream output card no longer blames the dream when a young kit consolidates nothing. Consolidation only revisits memories that have faded, and a kit a few months old has nothing faded yet. The card now warns only when memories are waiting and the night read none of them.
